concerns.text: The plan assumes a direct participant‑level linkage between the American Gut Project (AGP) 16S rRNA dataset and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) cognitive metadata (see step 1 and the Verified Sources table). In practice, AGP and HRS are unrelated cohorts with no shared participant identifiers, making the required overlap ≥ 500 highly implausible. This constitutes a wrong‑dataset choice for the research question and will cause the pipeline to abort at the fatal coverage‑gap check.
